law_name: Law No. 005/PR/2003 of 2 May 2003 on the Protection of Copyright, Neighbouring Rights and Expressions of Folklore
term_of_protection: Author's life + 70 years (Art. 39); joint works from last survivor's death (Art. 40); audiovisual and radio works 50 years (Art. 40)
orphan_works: No specific orphan-works scheme found; BUTDRA administers rights in heirless works (oeuvres en déshérence), folklore and waived works, proceeds used for cultural/social purposes (Decree 313/2005)
fair_use_exceptions: Folklore uses for profit outside traditional context need BUTDRA authorization against royalty (Arts. 82, 85, 86); other exceptions not seen (unconfirmed)
notes: Berne: bound from 25 Nov 1971 (Berne Notification 30). TRIPS from WTO membership lists (no date seen). Sources disagree on law number (005/PR/2003 vs 06/PR/2003) and BUTDRA creation (Law 05/PR/2003 of 23 May 2003). Moral rights, digital protection, registration not found
